method: Built-in image_gen precise edits of v2 templates
scope: Only four frameless samples; no approval to extend to other medals or integrate into production.

images.prompt: Precise edit of the supplied v2 medal. Remove the entire LARGE OUTERMOST ROUND GOLD FRAME, all four decorative cardinal diamond points attached to that outer frame, and the entire large round navy background plate. Make all removed areas genuinely transparent, including empty spaces BETWEEN the surviving parts. Retain the original central subject with its exact recognizable silhouette, composition, gold bevels, dark-blue subject accents, modeled depth and restrained highlights. Do not flatten it to an app pictogram. Do not invent a replacement frame, enclosing silhouette, shield, circular halo, new scenery or new symbols. No words, letters or numerals. Keep original subject colors as shape-review colors, no score-tier recoloring. Center the freed subject in a square transparent canvas with comfortable padding, about 85% maximum dimension. Only edit the specified outer backing; preserve the internal subject's identity. Keep ONLY the thick ascending gold zigzag arrow from lower-left to upper-right and a very small number of its nearby break-through fragments. Remove every enclosing circle and every navy background region behind the arrow. The central zigzag is the subject, not a straight arrow. Maintain its broad metallic bevel and darker edge facets. Leave transparent negative space around all bends.
